```{r}

tabla1 <- matrix(c(15,  3, 21, -2, 8, 19, 13, 14, -4, 26,  5, 13, 20,  7, 2,  9), nrow = 4, byrow = TRUE)

rownames(tabla1) <- c("$d_1$", "$d_2$", "$d_3$", "$d_4$")
colnames(tabla1) <- c("$e_1$", "$e_2$", "$e_3$", "$e_4$")

knitr::kable(tabla1)
```

```{r}
source("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mautils/teoriadecision/master/teoriadecision_funciones_incertidumbre.R")
res_wald_fav <- criterio.Wald(tabla1, favorable = TRUE)
res_wald_fav
```


```{r}
res_hurwicz_fav
```
